summary: Accept as test-only hardening. The exact deterministic encoder defect reproduces at the reporter image commit, while the recorded base already contains the production correction. The candidate adds a relevant passing regression and changes no production/native code. The unavailable 4x H200 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision serving behavior remains unverified, so the candidate itself is not classified as a full original-issue fix.

tests.command: execute encoding_dsv4.py fetched from 40b3e15ddbd9a1067e181283d9900dd3f4d76ed7 with serving-style dict and equivalent OpenAI JSON-string arguments
tests.what_was_measured: The dict encoded under a DSML parameter named arguments while the string encoded filePath directly, reproducing the reported deterministic cause.
Normalized JSON-string and dict inputs both encoded flat on the recorded base; nested values worked, non-object inputs were rejected, and a legitimate field named arguments was preserved.
Exact candidate regression: 3 tests passed with 2 subtests.
Four adjacent tests passed with six subtests across serving and DSV encoder boundaries.
Equivalent complex string/dict forms, nested arrays/booleans/null, empty strings, invalid top-level shapes, and a legitimate arguments field behaved according to contract.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 was visible through Torch ROCm, but the defect and candidate regression are CPU prompt-encoding paths. The reported 4x NVIDIA H200 model configuration was unavailable and was not approximated as equivalent.

remaining_counterexamples: No deterministic encoder counterexample was found for the tested OpenAI JSON-object contract.
End-to-end generation with DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision preview weights, 4x H200, TP=4, DSPARK, and the reported parsers was not available; stochastic follow-up tool-call output remains unverified.
The candidate is test-only and therefore does not itself supply the production correction; that correction predates the candidate in the prepared base.
remaining_limitations: The assigned environment is one gfx950 with ROCm 7.2, not four H200 GPUs with CUDA 13.
No full HTTP/model-serving or distributed execution was claimed from the CPU encoder fixture.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
